teaser.en: The pale nimakoba: one of a pair of brittle woodland mushrooms told apart by the colour of their caps.
teaser.sw: Nimakoba mweupe: mmoja wa jozi ya uyoga wa msituni unaovunjika kwa urahisi, inayotofautishwa kwa rangi ya kofia zake.
teaser.dg: *Nimakoba* mwereru: aina mwenga kahi ya aina mbiri za uoga wa matsakani unaovundzika rahisi, zinazotafwautishwa kpwa rangi ya kofiya zao.

summary.en: Nimakoba mwereru, the 'white nimakoba', is a brittlegill mushroom collected by Digo women. It is told apart from its red twin, nimakoba wa kundu, by the colour of its cap.
summary.sw: Nimakoba mwereru, 'nimakoba mweupe', ni uyoga wa jenasi *Russula* unaokusanywa na wanawake wa Kidigo. Hutofautishwa na pacha wake mwekundu, nimakoba wa kundu, kwa rangi ya kofia yake.
summary.dg: *Nimakoba mwereru*, '*nimakoba* mwereru', ni *Russula*, uoga unaovundzika rahisi, ambao achetu a Chidigo anautsola. Unatafwautishwa na nduguye wa kundu, *nimakoba wa kundu*, kpwa rangi ya kofiyaye.

about.en:
*Nimakoba mwereru* is a *Russula*, a brittlegill. These mushrooms have a firm, smooth cap on a short white stem, white to cream gills, and flesh that snaps cleanly like chalk rather than tearing. Unlike the milk caps, they give no milky juice when broken.

Digo mushroom collectors name their mushrooms mainly by cap colour, and this is the pale one.
about.sw:
*Nimakoba mwereru* ni *Russula*, uyoga unaovunjika kwa urahisi (kwa Kiingereza *brittlegill*). Uyoga huu una kofia ngumu laini juu ya shina fupi jeupe, matamvua meupe hadi ya rangi ya krimu, na nyama inayokatika safi kama chaki badala ya kuchanika. Tofauti na uyoga wa maziwa, haitoi utomvu kama maziwa unapovunjwa.

Wakusanyaji wa uyoga wa Kidigo huita uyoga wao hasa kwa rangi ya kofia, na huu ndio uliofifia.
about.dg:
*Nimakoba mwereru* ni *Russula*, uoga unaovundzika rahisi (kpwa Chingereza *brittlegill*). Uoga wa aina hino una kofiya ngumu na laini dzulu ya muhi mfupi mwereru, miraba (*gills*) mereru au ya rangi ya maziya, na nyama zinazovundzika sawa-sawa dza chokaa, si kuahuka. Tauna dza *milk caps*, kpwa sababu taulavya madzi dza maziya uchivundzika.

Adigo anaotsola uoga anaupha madzina hasa kpwa rangi ya kofiya, na huno ndio *nimakoba* mwereru.

where.en: Brittlegills grow on the ground in woodland, in partnership with the roots of trees. Digo collectors know three mushroom habitats: *Brachystegia* woodland (*mirihini*), farmland (*mdani*) and termite mounds (*tsuluni*), and look for each kind in its place.
where.sw: Uyoga wa aina hii huota ardhini msituni, ukishirikiana na mizizi ya miti. Wakusanyaji wa Kidigo wanatambua makazi matatu ya uyoga: msitu wa *Brachystegia* (*mirihini*), mashamba (*mdani*) na vichuguu (*tsuluni*), na hutafuta kila aina mahali pake.
where.dg: Uoga wa *Russula* unamera photsi matsakani, phamwenga na mizi ya mihi. Adigo anaotsola uoga anamanya aina hahu za phatu phanaphomera uoga: phatu phenye mirihi (*mirihini*), minda (*mdani*) na tsulu (*tsuluni*), na anaendza chila aina phahaliphe.

uses.en: Local people collect and eat it. Pakia notes that collectors prefer young mushrooms whose caps are still closed (*fundula*), because open caps (*bumula*) are usually infested by worms. Wild mushrooms should only be eaten when identified by someone with expert local knowledge.
uses.sw: Wenyeji huukusanya na kuula. Pakia anaeleza kuwa wakusanyaji hupendelea uyoga mchanga ambao kofia zake bado zimefunga (*fundula*), kwa sababu kofia zilizofunguka (*bumula*) kwa kawaida huwa zimevamiwa na funza. Uyoga wa porini unapaswa kuliwa tu ukiwa umetambuliwa na mtu mwenye ujuzi wa kina wa kienyeji.
uses.dg: Atu a phapha anautsola na kuurya. Pakia anaandika kukala anaotsola uoga anamendza uoga uchere mdide, kofiyaye ichikala bado ikafungbwa (*fundula*), kpwa sababu kofiya ichivugulika (*bumula*) mara nyinji uoga unakala na minyololo. Uoga wa weruni taufwaha kuriwa hadi umanyikane ni mutu mwenye ujuzi mkulu wa uoga wa phapha.

culture.en: Mushroom collecting is women's work among the Digo. Pakia found that only about ten kinds, the ones learnt from elders as edible, are eaten. All others are lumped together as *uoga koma*, 'wild' or poisonous mushrooms.
culture.sw: Kukusanya uyoga ni kazi ya wanawake miongoni mwa Wadigo. Pakia aligundua kuwa ni aina takriban kumi tu zinazoliwa, zile ambazo wazee walifundisha kuwa zinalika. Nyingine zote hujumuishwa pamoja kama *uoga koma*, uyoga 'wa porini' au wenye sumu.
culture.dg: Kutsola uoga ni kazi ya achetu kahi ya Adigo. Pakia waona kukala ni aina phephi kumi tu za uoga zinazoriwa, zira ambazo anadzifundza kula kpwa azehe kukala zinariwa. Uoga wanjina wosi unaihwa phamwenga *uoga koma*, uoga 'wa weruni' au wa sumu.

names.en: Pakia records *nimakoba mwereru*, 'white *nimakoba*', as one of two folk species of *nimakoba*, the other being *nimakoba wa kundu*, 'red *nimakoba*'. *Mwereru* is one of the three basic Digo colour words, for white and pale shades. The prefix *nima-* is one Pakia reads as carrying a 'female' sense. *Uoga* (Mgombato: *woga*) is the general word for mushroom.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi *nimakoba mwereru*, '*nimakoba* mweupe', kama mojawapo ya spishi mbili za kienyeji za *nimakoba*, nyingine ikiwa *nimakoba wa kundu*, '*nimakoba* mwekundu'. *Mwereru* ni mojawapo ya maneno matatu ya msingi ya rangi katika Kidigo, kwa rangi nyeupe na rangi zilizofifia. Pakia anakisoma kiambishi *nima-* kuwa kinabeba maana ya 'kike'. *Uoga* (Mgombato: *woga*) ndilo neno la jumla la uyoga.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika *nimakoba mwereru*, '*nimakoba* mwereru', kukala ni aina mwenga kahi ya aina mbiri za *nimakoba*; yanjina ni *nimakoba wa kundu*, '*nimakoba* wa kundu'. *Mwereru* ni mwenga wa maneno mahahu ga msingi ga rangi kpwa Chidigo, na ni rangi nyereru na rangi za ngushu-ngushu. Pakia anaona chiambishi *nima-* china mana ya 'mchetu'. *Uoga* (Mgombato: *woga*) ni neno ra chila uoga.
